decision: User2026-11-03 delegated best recommendation after direct CMYK-vs-conversion choice; architect selects supported RGB/grayscale direct JPEG and browser color conversion, no new paid/native service. This does not waive RGB valid maximum, full pixel validation, corruption or private lifecycle checks.
criteria: Small CMYK JPEG cannot bypass encoding through the small-file optimization. Converted bytes and MIME/name/digest describe the real result even when output is not smaller.

Known unsupported or unknown JPEG color model cannot fall back to original on decoder/encoder failure; explain conversion/export in ordinary language, preserve user file/draft, never stage incompatible original.
Supported RGB/grayscale small files and animated WebP preservation retain their existing semantics.
Real Chrome chooses actual generated CMYK JPEG, uploads a converted supported format and verifies actual private gallery/backend bytes; mocked bitmap unit tests alone are not browser proof.
Shared new JPEG_COLOR_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED is422/no-details with clear UI guidance; source limit/time policy is separately backend-reviewed.
